item.title: アップル、Ｍａｃのアクセス権限制御強化へ ＡＩリスク対策
item.description:
Stephen Nellis
[サンフランシスコ ２日 ロイター] - 米アップルは２日、同社のＰＣ「Ｍａｃ」の基本ソ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アップル、Ｍａｃのアクセス権限制御強化へ　ＡＩリスク対策 13:57 配信

3月にニューヨーク市で開催されたアップルのイベント　REUTERS/Shannon Stapleton

Stephen Nellis

[サンフランシスコ ２日 ロイター] - 米アップルは２日、同社のＰＣ「Ｍａｃ」の基本ソフト（ＯＳ）を修正すると明らかにした。人工知能（ＡＩ）エージェントがＭａｃ内の全データへのアクセスを求めた場合に、利用者がより明確に認識し対応できるようにする。

メタ・プラットフォームズのＡＩエージェント「Ｍｕｓｅ」について、一部ユーザーから、機密性の高い個人情報にアクセスされたとの批判が出ている。

アップルのスマートフォン「ｉＰｈｏｎｅ」やタブレット端末「ｉＰａｄ」では、「サンドボックス化」と呼ばれる仕組みにより、初期設定ではどのアプリも別のアプリ内のデータにアクセスできない。一方、Ｍａｃはより柔軟な設計となっており、利用者の許可があれば、クラウドバックアップサービスなどのアプリが端末内の全データにアクセスできる「フルディスクアクセス」という設定がある。

アップルは２日、自社のサイトで、一部の開発者が利用者を危険にさらしかねない形でフルディスクアクセス機能を使っていると指摘し、今後、追加の制御機能を導入すると表明した。

「ＡＩエージェントの能力と自律性が高まるにつれ、これほど広範なアクセスに伴うリスクは大幅に増大する。利用者が自身のデータとプライバシーについて十分な情報に基づいて判断できるよう、アクセスを許可する前にこうしたリスクを明確に理解できるようにすることに取り組む」とした。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：エヌビディア、ＡＩ半導体担保の巨大融資市場構想、資産価値巡りウォール街と溝 アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める コラム：ベセント氏の危うい賭け、ＡＩ主導の経済成長は「債務病」の特効薬ならず コラム：ＩＴサービス企業、生成ＡＩ追い風に株価上昇か コラム：ＡＩ投資を「黄金」に変えたマイクロソフト、アルファベットは羨望か 最終更新: 10/3(土) 13:57 ロイター

item.title: El Salvador pierde como local y queda cerca de descender en Liga de Naciones Concacaf
item.description: La selección de fútbol de El Salvador sufrió el viernes su segunda derrota consecutiva en la Liga de Naciones de la Concacaf al perder como local por 2-0 ante Jamaica con un doblete de Javon East, con lo que quedó en el último lugar del Grupo B de la Liga A y cerca de descender a la Liga B.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La selección de fútbol de El Salvador sufrió el viernes su segunda derrota consecutiva en la Liga de Naciones de la Concacaf al perder como local por 2-0 ante Jamaica con un doblete de Javon East, con lo que quedó en el último lugar del Grupo B de la Liga A y cerca de descender a la Liga B. Las selecciones que finalicen en quinto y sexto lugar de cada uno de los dos grupos de la Liga A descenderán a la Liga B. La "Selecta" ganó su primer partido de la competencia a Martinica por 3-1, pero posteriormente sufrió una goleada de 6-0 ante Guatemala, lo que la deja en el fondo del grupo por la diferencia negativa de goles. "No tengo palabras, es muy triste, algo que no esperábamos, quedamos a deber a nosotros mismos, al cuerpo técnico y a la afición. Así como ahorita estamos en el suelo nos vamos a levantar, vamos a salir adelante", dijo el defensa salvadoreño Jorge Cruz a la transmisión oficial de la Concacaf. El encuentro marcó el regreso de “La Selecta” -nombre coloquial del combinado centroamericano- al Estadio Cuscatlán de San Salvador, donde no jugaba desde el 14 de octubre de 2025, cuando perdió 0-1 ante Guatemala por las pasadas eliminatorias mundialistas. La selección dirigida por el colombiano Hernán Darío "Bolillo" Gómez, quien fue ratificado el miércoles, presentó cuatro cambios respecto a la goleada sufrida ante Guatemala. Al principio del encuentro, los salvadoreños parecieron mostrar una actitud más competitiva respecto a su anterior compromiso, producto del ingreso como titulares de Harold Osorio y Nathan Ordaz. Pero la situación se complicó a los 20 minutos cuando el zaguero Rudy Clavel vio la tarjeta roja tras una dura falta sobre el delantero Javon East, situación que aprovechó Jamaica para abrir el marcador a los 39 minutos cuando East se barrió en el área chica para empujar un centro enviado desde el sector izquierdo por Miguel Freckleton. En la parte complementaria, El Salvador mostró ímpetu, pero pocas ideas. Las dos opciones más claras de la selección local fueron generadas por jugadas individuales de Brayan Gil, que apenas inquietaron al portero jamaiquino Andre Blake. East marcó su doblete al minuto 64 cuando remató de zurda en el centro del área un pase de Jahmarie Nolan, quien estuvo cerca de anotar el tercero a los 67 con un peligroso remate de cabeza que desvió el guardameta. Los cerca de 9.500 aficionados que presenciaron una nueva derrota de El Salvador empezaron a abandonar el estadio antes de que finalizara el partido. El Salvador buscará su permanencia en la zona A el 5 de octubre cuando visite a Martinica en un partido que debe ganar y esperar una combinación de otros resultados. El presidente de la Federación Salvadoreña de Fútbol, Yamil Bukele, informó el miércoles que "Bolillo" Gómez renunciaría si se concreta el descenso a la Liga B. OTROS RESULTADOS En los otros partidos del grupo que se disputaron el viernes, Martinica remontó un gol en contra y venció por 2-1 a Honduras con tantos de Jonathan Varane y Jonathan Mexique a los 40 y 88 minutos, respectivamente. Erick Puerto había puesto en ventaja a los hondureños a los ocho minutos. En tanto, Surinam y Guatemala empataron sin goles. Con estos resultados, Surinam lidera el grupo con siete puntos, seguido por Jamaica con seis y Guatemala con cuatro. Más abajo se ubican Honduras, Martinica y El Salvador con tres unidades cada uno. En la última jornada del grupo que se disputará el 5 de octubre, Surinam visitará a Guatemala, mientras que Jamaica irá a Honduras. En el Grupo A, Costa Rica recompuso el jueves su camino al golear por 3-0 como visitante a Nicaragua en el partido que marcó el debut del ex jugador Bryan Ruiz como director técnico interino del representativo "tico" y el regreso del portero Keylor Navas. La Federación Costarricense de Fútbol (FCRF) nombró el lunes técnico interino a Ruiz, en sustitución del argentino Fernando Batista, quien fue despedido un día después de que la selección "tica" sufrió su segunda derrota consecutiva. En los otros partidos del jueves, Curazao ganó por 1-0 a Trinidad y Tobago, mientras que Haití goleó por 4-1 en su visita a República Dominicana. Curazao y Haití lideran el sector con nueve puntos cada uno, seguidos por República Dominicana con seis. Más abajo, se ubican Costa Rica con tres, además de Trinidad y Tobago y Nicaragua, que no han sumado. Los dos primeros lugares de cada uno de los dos grupos avanzarán a los cuartos de final, donde se unirán a las selecciones de México, Estados Unidos, Canadá y Panamá, que llegaron directamente a esa instancia por ser las mejores clasificadas de la Concacaf. Los ganadores de la fase de los cuartos de final clasificarán directamente a la Copa Oro del 2027. La Liga de Naciones es una competencia lanzada por la Concacaf en 2018 para garantizar que las 41 Asociaciones Miembro del organismo que rige el fútbol en Norteamérica, Centroamérica y El Caribe compitan regularmente en partidos oficiales entre las Copas del Mundo. Estados Unidos la ganó en 2021, 2023 y 2024. México logró el título en 2025.

item.title: Trump says US to send one-time $90 payment to 20 million seniors enrolled in Medicare
item.description: The payment to more than 20 million people is the latest promise the president has made to voters heading into the November midterms that will decide which party controls Congress.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump said the US government will send a one-time $90 payment to more than 20 million Americans enrolled in Medicare, a health insurance program for the elderly, to help offset the cost of their monthly medical insurance premiums. Trump said on social media late on Friday the payments will come from the Medicare Improvement Fund, which he said was given $2 billion by Congress to improve the Medicare fee-for-service program. The announcement is the latest in a series of financial promises the Republican leader has made to voters heading into the November midterm elections where control of Congress is at stake. Trump's Republican Party currently has a narrow majority in both the Senate and the House of Representatives but his approval rating [USN:L6N45D0NV TEXT:"has been low"] over his handling of the high cost of living for Americans during the US-Israeli war on Iran that has spiked oil and gas prices. The White House released some details of Trump's plan on its website, saying most eligible seniors will receive the payment in the form of a direct deposit of $90 in early October. Those without direct deposit will receive a check, also sent in early October, to the mailing address they have registered with Medicare, the White House said. Last month, Trump proposed sending [USN:L6N45211D TEXT:"$5,000 checks"] to all adult citizens if the Republicans keep control of the House and Senate in the midterms, though analysts, economists and even some Republicans in Congress [USN:L6N452119 TEXT:"reacted with skepticism"] to the plan. The Trump administration is also separately sending [USN:L6N45K16K TEXT:"$500 payments"] to nearly 1 million Americans in a move that strategists say could potentially influence some election races. The White House says those payments were a refund for what it describes as excessive fees charged to people who purchased health insurance through the Affordable Care Act.

item.title: 米政権主要閣僚、イラン戦争やフーシ派巡り大統領山荘で協議 米報道
item.description: ［２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２日　ロイター］ - トランプ米政権の主要閣僚が２日、大統領山荘キャンプデービッドに集まり、イラン戦争、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派とサウジアラビアの紛争への対応を協議した。米ニュースサイトのアクシオスが複数の米当局者の話として伝えた。

アクシオスによると、会合はバンス副大統領が主宰し、ルビオ国務長官、ヘグセス国防長官、ウィットコフ大統領特使、ラトクリフ中央情報局（ＣＩＡ）長官、ケイン統合参謀本部議長らが参加した。トランプ政権はこの会合について公表していないが、当局者の１人は「物事が決定された、あるいは少なくとも掘り下げた議論が行われた」と述べたという。

トランプ氏は２日午後、記者団からイランに対する次の一手について問われ、「それを話せば、大ニュースになるだろう」と述べ、「いずれ分かる。非常にうまく進んでいる。イランは厳しい状況だ」と語った。

中東や欧米当局者はロイターに、サウジがフーシ派に対する攻勢を計画していると述べた。紅海の海上輸送路の確保に向け沿岸部で攻勢をかける案や、複数の戦線で同時攻撃を仕掛ける案などが検討されており、向こう数週間以内に開始する可能性があるという。

item.title: Joel Hofer, Blues start season with shutout win over Stars
item.description: Joel Hofer made 25 saves for his ninth career shutout and contributed an assist as the visiting St. Louis Blues beat the Dallas Stars 4-0 on Friday in the season opener for both teams.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Joel Hofer made 25 saves for his ninth career shutout and contributed an assist as the visiting St. Louis Blues beat the Dallas Stars 4-0 on Friday in the season opener for both teams. Pius Suter and Jimmy Snuggerud each had a goal and an assist and Mason McTavish and Dalibor Dvorsky also scored for the Blues. Stars goalie Jake Oettinger stopped 20 shots. It took McTavish just 1:34 into the game and the 2026-27 season to pick up his first goal as a Blue after being obtained from the Anaheim Ducks in an offseason trade. McTavish put in a loose puck from just outside the crease to give St. Louis a 1-0 lead. Hofer made a big save on Tyler Seguin's tip attempt on a Dallas power play in the final seconds of the opening period. St. Louis' Alexey Toropchenko was helped off the ice and left the game 3:28 into the second period after being sandwiched between two Dallas players along the boards behind the Blues' net. It appeared to be an arm or shoulder injury. Dvorsky made it 2-0 with 6:55 left in the second on only St. Louis' second shot of the period. Capitalizing on a Dallas turnover behind its own net, Dvorsky scored from the inside edge of the right circle after taking a pass from defenseman Philip Broberg. Oettinger fell after teammate Roope Hintz accidentally tripped the goalie as Oettinger tried to get back to the crease from behind the net. An apparent power-play goal by Blues defenseman Adam Jiricek, who was making his NHL debut, 1:06 into the third period was wiped out by Dallas' successful coach's challenge for offside. Hintz was helped off the ice 2:49 into the third period after a knee-on-knee hit by St. Louis defenseman Brandon Carlo, who was assessed a kneeing major and game misconduct. Hintz returned minutes later. Snuggerud and Suter picked up empty-net goals 15 seconds apart in the final 2:30. Hofer got an assist on Suter's goal. --Field Level Media

item.title: Shohei Ohtani set to hit in NLDS despite not being fully healthy
item.description: Shohei Ohtani admitted he won't be at full strength when he bats for the Dodgers in the National League Division Series against the Atlanta Braves, which begins Saturday in Los Angeles.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Shohei Ohtani admitted he won't be at full strength when he bats for the Dodgers in the National League Division Series against the Atlanta Braves, which begins Saturday in Los Angeles. The four-time Most Valuable Player had a stint on the 15-day injured list in September due to right biceps and left knee issues that are still troubling him. He returned to go 5-for-21 (.238) with one extra-base hit, a double, and one RBI in the final five regular-season games. Speaking about his health, Ohtani said Friday through an interpreter, "I haven't been able to get a good grasp of the root cause of all this. I think that process is going to happen during the offseason when I'm going to have a little bit more time to be able to address it. But as of now, it's something I'm just going to have to manage." The two-way star previously was ruled out from any possible pitching work in the postseason -- and he hasn't taken the mound since July 3. "During the IL (stint), I pretty much knew I wasn't going to pitch the rest of the season," Ohtani said. "So I did focus on just the hitting aspect of the game and coming to understanding and wanting to execute and try new things when I came back. So, those were the things that I really took the IL time to think through what I wanted to try when I was back in action." Ohtani saw his offense fall off late in the season. In his final 18 games as the designated hitter, he went 11-for-70 (.157) with no homers and one RBI. Still, Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said, "Shohei's not 100%, but he's going to be in the lineup. ... I think that most players that are performing now are not 100%. Obviously with Shohei, it's a bigger deal because of the player, but there's a lot of players that are not 100%, and they've just got to manage it. ... "I know that once the lights turn on, the postseason starts, the focus will be heightened. I expect good things. I really do. We just haven't seen it enough ... for me to forecast it." Overall on the season, Ohtani batted .275 with a .377 on-base percentage, a .512 slugging percentage, 30 homers and 81 RBIs in 139 games. In his abbreviated pitching campaign, he went 8-2 with a 1.79 ERA, 95 strikeouts and 26 walks in 85 2/3 innings. --Field Level Media

item.title: US judge dismisses DOJ lawsuit that used abortion clinic access law against protesters
item.description: A US judge dismissed a lawsuit against pro-Palestinian organizations and protesters that President Donald Trump's administration brought last year under a law traditionally used against people blocking access to abortion clinics.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: A US judge dismissed a [USN:L6N3VG0UL TEXT:"lawsuit"] against pro-Palestinian organizations and protesters that President Donald Trump's administration brought last year under a law traditionally used against people blocking access to abortion clinics. US District Judge Katharine Hayden in New Jersey said the government's complaint did not adequately plead violations of the statute. She dismissed the claims without prejudice, saying the government can file an amended complaint within 30 days. The case was brought under the Freedom of Access to Clinic Entrances Act, or FACE Act, a 1994 law that prohibits the use of force and physical obstruction to interfere with people at reproductive health centers or houses of worship. In September 2025, the Justice Department sued pro-Palestinian activists that it accused of intimidating attendees during a November 2024 protest against an event at a synagogue in New Jersey. The event was billed by organizers as a spiritual service and real estate fair. It promoted the sale of property in Israeli settlements in the Israeli-occupied West Bank. The lawsuit said the protest escalated into violence, alleging the demonstrators physically assaulted some worshippers and chanted and used vuvuzelas - plastic trumpets sometimes used by soccer fans - to disrupt the event. The Justice Department has brought several cases against protesters who have obstructed abortion clinics, but the case appeared to be the first time the law was used to allege interference with religious worship, according to Harmeet Dhillon, the head of the Justice Department's Civil Rights Division. The Justice Department under Trump has curtailed the use of the FACE Act in abortion-related cases, alleging that past criminal prosecutions represented an improper politicized use of law enforcement. Dhillon said those restrictions do not apply to cases related to houses of worship. Last year, Trump pardoned several people prosecuted under the law. Trump has [USN:L4N3SN13Z TEXT:"attempted to deport"] foreign pro-Palestinian protesters, threatened [USN:FWN3TK1JE TEXT:"funding freezes"] for universities where protests were held, expanded [USN:L3N3QN23Z TEXT:"social media screening"] of immigrants and imposed [USN:S8N3S608Z TEXT:"sanctions on some of Israel's critics"]. His administration says pro-Palestinian protesters are antisemitic and support extremists. Demonstrators say their criticism of [USN:L4N44O22P TEXT:"Israeli attacks on Gaza"] and of Israel's occupation of Palestinian territories does not amount to antisemitism, and their advocacy for Palestinian rights should not be equated with supporting extremism.

item.title: JJ Peterka's overtime goal lifts Bruins past Jets
item.description: JJ Peterka scored with 1:39 left in overtime to propel the visiting Boston Bruins to a come-from-behind, 4-3 win over the Winnipeg Jets on Friday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: JJ Peterka scored with 1:39 left in overtime to propel the visiting Boston Bruins to a come-from-behind, 4-3 win over the Winnipeg Jets on Friday night. David Pastrnak laid a pass ahead to Peterka as the duo surged in transition, and the Boston newcomer finished the deciding tally five-hole on Winnipeg's Stuart Skinner, who made 11 of his 26 stops in the third period and overtime. It was Peterka's second goal in as many games with Boston. Pastrnak assisted on Boston's final two goals. Elias Lindholm scored an extra-attacker goal with 1:38 left in regulation to force the game to the extra frame. Hampus Lindholm and James Hagens (first NHL goal) also scored while Jeremy Swayman made 30 saves for Boston, which has started the season with back-to-back wins. Kyle Connor had a power-play goal and added an assist, Mario Ferraro and Dylan DeMelo also lit the lamp, and Adam Lowry dished out a pair of helpers for the Jets in their season opener. After Skinner made several saves and got help from his right post on a Marat Khusnutdinov tip with 7:31 left in the third, the visitors' pressure paid off in a tying goal when Elias Lindholm was perfectly stationed between the circles to redirect a Pastrnak shot from above the right circle. Connor nearly ended the game in Winnipeg's favor 1:12 into the extra session, but he hit the left post after sliding through two defenders to attack the net. An opening goal at 4:52 highlighted Winnipeg's dominant start to the first. After Morgan Barron circled the zone and banked a pass off the boards, DeMelo blasted a point shot that changed direction and beat Swayman over his shoulder for a 1-0 lead. At the other end, Hampus Lindholm knotted the score with a point shot of his own at 9:23. Morgan Geekie picked up the puck along the wall and spun a feed to his defenseman for a blast that slipped past Skinner's glove. Hagens gave Boston its first lead with his milestone goal with 4:40 left before first intermission, cleaning up a loose puck in the crease after Mark Kastelic made a tough net drive. The Jets needed only 16 seconds of power-play time to make it 2-2 at 1:50 of the second. Cole Perfetti's turnaround shot led to a net-mouth scramble, with Connor corralling a loose puck at the right crease and sneaking it through traffic. Ferraro put Winnipeg back ahead in the middle frame with only eight seconds remaining, lasering a shot from the top of the left circle that appeared to clip Pastrnak on its way into the top corner. --Field Level Media

item.title: ＯＰＥＣプラスの生産能力評価、11月中旬にずれ込みか 中東紛争が影響
item.description:
Alex Lawler Olesya Astakhova
［ロンドン／モスクワ ２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Alex Lawler　Olesya Astakhova

［ロンドン／モスクワ　２日　ロイター］ - 石油輸出国機構（ＯＰＥＣ）加盟国とロシアなど非加盟産油国で構成する「ＯＰＥＣプラス」で、加盟国の２０２７年の原油生産枠（クオータ）設定に向けた生産能力の評価作業が遅れていることが関係者の話で分かった。イラン戦争で中東の増産計画が混乱し、生産予測が不透明になっているという。

生産能力評価は２０２６年９月末までに完了する予定だったが、関係者によると、１１月中旬になる見通し。

ＯＰＥＣプラス加盟国の生産能力の試算は米石油コンサルタント会社のデゴルヤー・アンド・マクノートンが行っている。米国の制裁下にあるロシア、イラン、ベネズエラは対象外。

関係筋によると、同社のＯＰＥＣへの報告書提出は１１月半ばになる。この日程でも、ＯＰＥＣプラスは１１月下旬に開く次回の全体会合で評価結果を検討できる。

中東紛争により、一部加盟国で生産能力の拡大を予定していた事業に遅れが生じている。関係筋は、名指しを控えつつ、評価に必要なデータを提出していない国もあると述べた。

item.title: Aprilia's Martin sets lap record at Japanese MotoGP to snatch pole from Marquez
item.description: Aprilia's Jorge Martin set a lap record to grab pole position at the Japanese Grand Prix on Saturday ahead of title rival and defending MotoGP champion Marc Marquez.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Aprilia's Jorge Martin set a lap record to grab pole position at the Japanese Grand Prix on Saturday ahead of title rival and defending MotoGP champion Marc Marquez. Ducati's Marquez held provisional pole with his time of 1 minute 42.481 seconds, but a late scorching 1:42.371 from Martin catapulted the championship leader to the top of the timesheets. "It's a situation that I'm getting used to, we struggle a bit on Friday, then we do a great job trying to analyse well, and then we make a big step on Saturday," Martin said. "That was the target. I didn't expect to fight for the pole position. I was aiming maybe for the first row, but I was able to do a great lap, honestly." Martin leads Marquez by 12 points in the championship and will look to widen that gap in Saturday's sprint and Sunday's race. For Marquez, qualifying ended in frustration after a few late errors, including an excursion onto the gravel while pushing for a faster time. "I'm happy, but of course, with that second tyre, too many mistakes. I was just able to push in the last lap, and again, another big mistake," he said. "Starting in the front row was the main target. Let's see if in the sprint race we can do a good pace." KTM's Pedro Acosta, who claimed the [USN:L1N45C039 TEXT:"first MotoGP victory of his career"] in the Austrian Grand Prix last month, completed the front row. Japan's Ai Ogura of Trackhouse Racing was 11th-quickest after topping the first qualifying session.

item.title: Tyler Adams selected captain of USMNT for new World Cup cycle
item.description: Veteran midfielder Tyler Adams regained the captaincy of the U.S. men's national team on Friday with the squad in the early stages of preparation for a run at the 2030 World Cup.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Veteran midfielder Tyler Adams regained the captaincy of the U.S. men's national team on Friday with the squad in the early stages of preparation for a run at the 2030 World Cup. Defender Tim Ream was the captain this summer, when the U.S. reached the round of 16 before losing to Belgium. Ream, 38, announced Tuesday that he was retiring from international soccer, and the U.S. Soccer Federation honored him that night at a friendly against Chile in his hometown of St. Louis. Adams, 27, was the USMNT's captain at the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, where he played every minute. The U.S. lost in the round of 16 that year, falling to the Netherlands. "Tyler is going to be our next -- our new captain, our captain again," U.S. coach Mauricio Pochettino said Friday in Tempe, Ariz., ahead of the squad's Saturday match vs. Mexico in Glendale, Ariz. "I think we've been (in) a very good relationship in the last two years. I think we were talking a lot, and I think he knows what I expect, and he's a perfect role model for everyone in the way that the philosophy, the future, representing that amazing country. I think he's the player and the person that can lead that period that we have ahead. And I (say) congratulations." Adams replied, "I'm extremely honored and grateful for the opportunity. I think that, like Mauricio said, we've obviously built an amazing relationship over the past two years with all the staff, with my teammates here, going into this past World Cup. "And I think as we start a new cycle, I'm excited to be able to help my teammates and the staff in any way possible in order to win, grow the federation and ultimately take that next step. So, I appreciate it." In 60 career matches for the USMNT, Adams has two goals -- both against Mexico. "Getting the armband, it doesn't mean anything to me in being a leader or being different from who I am," Adams said. "I'm gonna be the exact same person. I'm gonna try to lead this group into a winning culture and continue to build what we're trying to build here. I want to represent my teammates in the best way possible. I want to represent the country in the best way possible, of course." Adams is in his fourth season with Bournemouth in England's Premier League. He spent 2018-22 with RB Leipzig in Germany's Bundesliga, then played the 2022-23 season with Leeds United in the Premier League. The Wappingers Falls, N.Y., native began his career with Major League Soccer's New York Red Bulls. --Field Level Media

item.title: China initiates anti-dumping investigation into p-nitrotoluene from EU
item.description: China's Commerce Ministry said on Saturday it had launched an anti-dumping investigation into imports of chemical intermediate p-nitrotoluene from the European Union.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: China's Commerce Ministry said on Saturday it had launched an anti-dumping investigation into imports of chemical intermediate p-nitrotoluene from the European Union. P-nitrotoluene, also known as para-nitrotoluene, is used in the production of dyes, pharmaceuticals and pesticides. China is a major producer and exporter of p-nitrotoluene. The ministry said the probe was initiated after a complaint from China's domestic industry. Preliminary evidence showed the prices of EU imports fell nearly 60% cumulatively between 2022 and 2025, it said. The investigation comes amid growing trade tensions between China and the European Union, which have increasingly resorted to anti-dumping and other trade defence measures targeting each other's products.

item.title: Boca Juniors golea a Unión con doblete de Flores en liga argentina
item.description: Un doblete del joven internacional Leonel Flores y un gol de Lautaro Di Lollo le dieron a Boca Juniors un triunfo por 3-0 como local ante Unión de Santa Fe en la undécima jornada del torneo Clausura del fútbol argentino.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Un doblete del joven internacional Leonel Flores y un gol de Lautaro Di Lollo le dieron a Boca Juniors un triunfo por 3-0 como local ante Unión de Santa Fe en la undécima jornada del torneo Clausura del fútbol argentino. "Sé que esto recién empieza, pero estoy muy contento con mi presente, por la selección y estos goles en este estadio. Por suerte se están dando las cosas muy bien", dijo Flores a la televisión local. En el partido disputado en el estadio La Bombonera, Boca Juniors abrió el marcador a los 22 minutos con un remate de cabeza de Lautaro Di Lollo tras un centro de Leandro Paredes. El popular conjunto argentino completó la goleada a los 83 y 92 minutos con el doblete del ingresado Flores, quien días atrás, con 19 años, tuvo su debut en la selección de Argentina. "Hay que seguir por la senda del triunfo, porque todavía no conseguimos nada, esta es la realidad. Quedan rivales muy duros", dijo el zaguero uruguayo Leandro Lozano tras la victoria. Con este resultado, Boca llegó a 20 puntos y subió al segundo lugar de la tabla de posiciones de la Zona A, a cinco unidades del líder Instituto de Córdoba, que goleó por 4-1 a Independiente de Avellaneda con tantos de Jeremías Lázaro, Hernán De la Fuente, Matías Gallardo y Alex Luna, mientras que para Independiente anotó Maximiliano Meza, quien salió expulsado a los 44 minutos. En otro partido del viernes, Gimnasia y Esgrima La Plata rescató un empate agónico de 1-1 en su visita a Independiente Rivadavia de Mendoza gracias a un gol de Agustín Colazo a los 86 minutos. El conjunto local había abierto el marcador a los cinco minutos por intermedio de Juan Manuel Elordi.

item.title: Paraguay vence a Colombia en amistoso internacional
item.description: La selección paraguaya de fútbol, con un gol de Hugo Benítez, venció el viernes 1-0 a Colombia en el segundo partido amistoso de los dos equipos después del Campeonato Mundial 2026.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La selección paraguaya de fútbol, con un gol de Hugo Benítez, venció el viernes 1-0 a Colombia en el segundo partido amistoso de los dos equipos después del Campeonato Mundial 2026. El partido se jugó en el Sports Illustrated Stadium de Nueva Jersey, en Estados Unidos. Al inicio del primer tiempo, Paraguay, dirigida por el entrenador argentino Gustavo Alfaro, asumió el control de la pelota y del partido, ocupó los espacios del medio campo y encerró a Colombia en su propio campo. La selección colombiana, bajo las órdenes del técnico argentino Néstor Lorenzo, tardó diez minutos en salir con posesión del balón y generar su primer avance ofensivo sobre el área paraguaya. Con el paso de los minutos, Colombia equilibró el partido, manejó el balón y tuvo aproximaciones ofensivas que no concretó, mientras que Paraguay se defendió con un bloque sólido y una marca anticipada en el medio campo para impedir el juego colectivo de la selección cafetera. El equipo guaraní también generó peligro colectivamente frente al arco de Colombia, pero sin efectividad. En el segundo tiempo, Paraguay retomó el control del partido y del balón, y llegó con insistencia al área de Colombia, que intentó defenderse y salir al contraataque con sorpresa y velocidad. La Albirroja abrió el marcador en el minuto 56, tras un centro que la defensa colombiana no logró despejar. El delantero Hugo Benítez aprovechó el error y, en dos tiempos, venció al arquero Aldair Quintana y mandó el balón al fondo de la red. Con el marcador en contra, Colombia reaccionó y se volcó al ataque frente a una selección paraguaya que se replegó con una doble línea de cuatro y presionó por todos los sectores de la cancha para neutralizar el juego colectivo del equipo rival. La selección colombiana, que venía de empatar 1-1 con México, buscó el gol del empate, pero le faltaron creación en el medio campo y generación de juego. El equipo cafetero enfrentará el próximo martes en otro amistoso a Perú, en Miami. Paraguay, que venció 2-0 a Bolivia en su primer amistoso, jugará contra Singapur el 13 de noviembre.

item.title: テニス＝ジョコビッチ、今季は「本当に苦しい」 体力でなく健康問題
item.description: ［北京 ２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［北京　２日　ロイター］ - テニスの四大大会で２４回の優勝を誇るノバク・ジョコビッチ（セルビア）が、２日の中国オープン（ＯＰ）で再びメディカルタイムアウトを必要とした後、今年は非常に苦しいシーズンを過ごしてきたと語った。原因はスタミナ不足ではなく、公表していない健康上の問題にあるという。

ジョコビッチはシングルス２回戦で、世界ランキング１０４位のブ・ユンチャオケテ（中国）と対戦し、４─６、７─６、６─２で逆転勝利。史上最多６回の優勝を果たしている中国ＯＰでの成績を３１勝０敗とした。

ジョコビッチは今年の全米ＯＰで、試合中に嘔吐したほか、背中や肩の不調にも悩まされた。終盤にはサーブにも影響が出て、２００６年の全豪ＯＰ以来となる四大大会初戦敗退に終わっていた。

１１年ぶりの出場となった今大会、１回戦でもメディカルタイムアウトを要求していたジョコビッチは、記者会見で自身の状態について、「詳細を話すつもりはない。そうすると、何かへの不満や言い訳を探しているように聞こえてしまうからだ。実のところ、今年はいくつかの問題に悩まされ、私にとって本当に厳しいシーズンとなっている」と語った。

「今年出場した試合や大会のほとんどは、フィジカル的に本当に、本当に苦しいものだった。それはスタミナの問題ではない。みんなはそこを混同しがちだが、スタミナではなく別の問題だ。健康面により関係していることだ」と述べた。

item.title: High-scoring Oilers seek better defense vs. Kraken
item.description: With four of their top seven forwards on the injured list, it would figure the Edmonton Oilers might be struggling to score.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: With four of their top seven forwards on the injured list, it would figure the Edmonton Oilers might be struggling to score. But that has not been the case through the first two games of the season. Not even close. After taking a 6-5 overtime loss to visiting Vancouver in the opener Tuesday, the Oilers rebounded Thursday with a 9-7 victory in Vancouver. The Oilers will try to light the goal lamp at the same rate while tightening things up in their own zone when they play host to the Seattle Kraken on Saturday. "We know we can be way better," said Oilers coach Mike Babcock. "What I saw (Thursday) was a group that could play right and knew what they were doing, and then I saw a group that didn't do it. So, the main thing is if you know you can do it, now you got to find a way to just repeat, repeat, rinse, repeat, do it again." Connor McDavid had a goal and four assists, Leon Draisaitl added two goals and an assist and Evan Bouchard had a goal and two helpers for the Oilers, who outshot Vancouver 14-2 in the first period in taking a 4-0 lead. They pushed their lead to 8-2 before the Canucks scored with 0.1 seconds left in the second. Then the Oilers, who were without injured forwards Zach Hyman, Ryan Nugent-Hopkins, Jason Dickinson and Matthew Savoie, had to hang on. "No one is in here being, you know, 'Way to go,'" McDavid said. "Obviously we understand the game has got to look a little bit different, but I thought, the first 40 (minutes) is what it could look like a lot of the time, and what it should look like a lot of the time. Guys working hard, tracking back, responsible with the puck and just kind of rolling over them. That 40 minutes we have to replicate night in and night out." The Kraken got their season off to a good start Thursday in Calgary with a 6-1 victory, spoiling the Flames' final home opener at the Saddledome before they move into a new facility next year. Defenseman Vince Dunn posted one goal and two assists for the Kraken. Jared McCann added three assists, and Matty Beniers and Kaapo Kakko each had a goal and an assist. Goaltender Joey Daccord made 24 saves and preserved his shutout until 3:25 remained. "It's good to see us start that way," said Dunn, whose team took a 3-0 lead by the end of the first period. "It's good to get the confidence rolling. It's a quick turnaround after preseason, but by the looks of it, the legs feel good by everyone, and I think everyone really got into that game. It was a pretty well-rounded team effort there, so that's huge." Kraken captain Jordan Eberle opened the scoring with a power-play goal at 9:10 of the first period. "It's always nice to win the first game," Eberle said. "It's a long season. This is not a sprint, it's a marathon. You have to temper. There's always video and there's always things you can improve on. At the end of the day for us to be successful this season, we need to get better over the entire year and we're going to do that." --Field Level Media

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝フィリーズ、マッティングリー暫定監督が退任へ─報道
item.description: ［２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）のフィリーズが、ドン・マッティングリー暫定監督（６５）を退任させる方針だという。ＵＳＡトゥデーが２日に報じた。来週にも退任の見通しだが、球団は別の役職で残留する機会を提示するという。

フィリーズは今季レギュラーシーズンを８８勝７４敗で終え、１日に行われたブレーブスとのナ・リーグのワイルドカードシリーズ第３戦に２─６で敗戦。シリーズ敗退が決まった。

マッティングリー氏は１月、ロブ・トムソン前監督の下でベンチコーチとしてフィリーズに加入。ドジャースを２０１１─１５年、マーリンズを１６─２２年に率いた経験を持つマッティングリー氏はコーチ就任当時、監督への復帰に関心はないと話していたが、フィリーズが４月２８日に９勝１９敗の不振を受け、トムソン前監督を解任し、マッティングリー氏を暫定監督に昇格させた。

その後、チームは持ち直した。７月１８日時点で５５勝４４敗、マッティングリー氏就任後で４６勝２５敗を記録したが、７月末に失速。９月も１０勝１４敗にとどまり、最終的にナ・リーグ第３ワイルドカードでポストシーズンに進出した。

item.title: Alex Tuch excels in Capitals debut as Hurricanes' slow start continues
item.description: Alex Tuch scored two first-period goals in his first game with Washington, allowing the Capitals to coast to a season-opening 5-2 victory against the Carolina Hurricanes on Friday night at Raleigh, N.C.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Alex Tuch scored two first-period goals in his first game with Washington, allowing the Capitals to coast to a season-opening 5-2 victory against the Carolina Hurricanes on Friday night at Raleigh, N.C. Jakob Chychrun had a goal and an assist while Cole Hutson and Ryan Leonard also scored for the Capitals, who opened their schedule three nights after some other teams in the NHL. Dylan Strome and Pierre-Luc Dubois each had two assists for Washington while Alex Ovechkin, beginning his 22nd season, added an assist. Capitals goalie Logan Thompson stopped 31 shots. Sebastian Aho and Logan Stankoven scored for Carolina, which needed nearly 102 minutes of game time to put the puck in the net at the outset of its title defense. Hurricanes goalie Brandon Bussi, playing for the second time this week, made 22 saves. The defending champion Hurricanes, who lost 1-0 in overtime to the visiting Florida Panthers on Tuesday, haven't yet found traction. This was a much more free-flowing game than Tuesday night, but that didn't benefit the Hurricanes. Tuch, who was acquired in a June trade with the Buffalo Sabres, scored 6:33 into the game on a wrist shot. After Hutson's goal five minutes later, Tuch's second goal on a backhanded delivery gave Washington a 3-0 lead 14:23 into the game. After Chychrun's power-play goal early in the second period, the Capitals held a 4-0 lead until Aho scored Carolina's first goal of the season with 3:10 remaining in the second, also on a power play. There wasn't any momentum for the Hurricanes from that. Washington responded eight seconds later with Leonard's goal to restore its four-goal advantage. Ovechkin's assist on Tuch's goal gave the veteran winger 759 career assists, three shy of Nicklas Backstrom's franchise record. Stankoven had the only third-period goal for either team. The Hurricanes more than doubled their number of shots on goal from the Florida game, from 15 to 33. --Field Level Media

item.title: Lawyer demands 'accountability' after ex-deputy who shot Black airman is acquitted
item.description: Civil rights attorney Ben Crump on Friday vowed to "seek accountability" in the 2024 shooting death of US Air Force airman Roger Fortson after a jury in Florida acquitted former sheriff's deputy Eddie Duran of manslaughter.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Trotta
item.content:encoded: Civil rights attorney Ben Crump on Friday vowed to "seek accountability" in the 2024 shooting death of US Air Force airman Roger Fortson after a jury in Florida acquitted former sheriff's deputy Eddie Duran of manslaughter. Duran's defense attorney said the former deputy was "doing his job" that day and said Fortson would be alive had he not armed himself before opening his door. Their statements came the day after jurors in the four-day trial returned a not guilty verdict following about two hours of deliberations. Duran, a deputy with the Okaloosa County Sheriff's Office, fatally shot Fortson, 23, moments after he opened his apartment door on May 3, 2024. In a statement, the office of State Attorney Ginger Bowden Madden urged the public to respond "peacefully" to the verdict. "We understand that this verdict will cause pain, anger, or disappointment for many people, particularly some members of the community who view Senior Airman Fortson's death within a context of encounters nationally involving law enforcement," the statement said. The shooting of Fortson was national news at the time, fueling debate over race and police use of force as a number of controversial police shootings of Black men have come to light with the advance of video technology in recent years. Okaloosa Sheriff Eric Aden [USN:L8N3HZ02I TEXT:"fired Duran"] a month later, saying the use of deadly force was not reasonable. [USN:L1N3HC1QE TEXT:"Video"] from the deputy's body camera showed Fortson opened his door while holding a handgun at his side and pointed toward the floor. The deputy immediately opened fire multiple times at close range. Fortson later died in the hospital. Crump has won multimillion-dollar settlements for families of other Black people killed by police, including $27 million from the city of Minneapolis for the 2020 murder of George Floyd and $12 million from the city of Louisville for the death of Breonna Taylor that same year. He has filed a federal civil rights case against Duran, the Okaloosa County Sheriff's Office, and others on behalf of Fortson's family. "Roger's life and his service will always matter. His family will keep fighting for him, and we will stand with them as they pursue their civil rights case in federal court and seek accountability for the tragic loss of life," Crump said in a statement. In an interview with WEAR television news that aired on Friday, Duran's defense attorney, Rod Smith, said what happened was a "tragedy" but not a crime because his client simply followed his training after seeing an armed man. Fortson should have "simply opened the door" without holding a gun, Smith said. Fortson's family said the deputy knocked on the wrong door when responding to a disturbance complaint. Prosecutors presented evidence at trial that deputies were responding to a complaint that did not involve Fortson. Fortson, a senior airman, served in the 4th Special Operations Squadron at Hurlburt Field. The Air Force posthumously awarded him the Air and Space Commendation Medal for meritorious service while assigned as a special missions aviator.

item.title: La Corée du Nord tire un missile balistique au large de sa côte orientale
item.description: La Corée du Nord a tiré samedi un missile balistique au large de sa côte orientale, ont dit la Corée du Sud et le Japon.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Corée du Nord a tiré samedi un missile balistique au large de sa côte orientale, ont dit la Corée du Sud et le Japon. Le missile a été lancé de la région de Wonsan vers 06h30 samedi matin (21h30 GMT vendredi), a indiqué l'armée sud-coréenne dans un communiqué. Les garde-côtes japonais ont dit dans un communiqué citant le ministère de la Défense, qu'il était possible que le projectile ait été un missile balistique. L'armée sud-coréenne a dit avoir relevé sa surveillance et qu'elle partagerait ses renseignements avec les Etats-Unis et le Japon. Le conseil de sécurité nationale de la présidence sud-coréenne a convoqué une réunion d'urgence samedi pour évaluer la situation après le tir de missile, a fait savoir la Maison bleue.

item.title: Japan shifts messaging to counter view its policies are reflationary, Katayama says in TV interview
item.description: Japan's government has begun recalibrating its messaging to reassure markets that Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is not pursuing reflationary policies, Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said in an interview with broadcaster TV Tokyo on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Japan's government has begun recalibrating its messaging to reassure markets that Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi is not pursuing reflationary policies, Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said in an interview with broadcaster TV Tokyo on Saturday. US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent views Takaichi's economic policies as suited to current economic conditions, but has questioned whether the government has been communicating that message clearly enough to investors, Katayama said. "So we concluded around late August that we need to communicate that message more clearly to financial markets," Katayama said, addressing market perceptions that the administration's policies are reflationary.

item.title: Dylan Garand picks up first shutout as Rangers top Red Wings
item.description: Dylan Garand posted his first career shutout while making 22 saves as the New York Rangers blanked the host Detroit Red Wings 2-0 on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Dylan Garand posted his first career shutout while making 22 saves as the New York Rangers blanked the host Detroit Red Wings 2-0 on Friday. Sean Durzi scored on a first-period power play and Eeli Tolvanen chipped in an empty-net goal to spoil Detroit's season opener. Garand was making his first start this season after going 2-0-1 in three appearances for the Rangers last season. New York was playing the second game of a back-to-back and its third game overall. The Rangers defeated the Tampa Bay Lightning 5-1 at home on Thursday. John Gibson made 19 saves for the Red Wings, who were missing two of their top players. Former captain and first-line center Dylan Larkin, who has requested a trade, was sidelined by an upper-body injury. Larkin was booed during pregame introductions and some fans chanted "Sell the team!" at various points of the contest. Restricted free agent Simon Edvinsson, one of the team's top defensemen, remains unsigned amid stalled negotiations. The Rangers took the lead at 5:12 of the first period on a power play. With Nate Danielson in the penalty box, Gabe Perreault passed the puck from the right circle to the high slot, where Durzi ripped a one-timer past Gibson. Will Cuylle picked up the second assist. Durzi had another apparent goal two minutes later wiped out by a Red Wings challenge for being offside. Detroit's Anton Johansson banged a shot off the right post later in the period. Garand stopped a J.T. Compher shot from point-blank range midway through the second period. Durzi and Marco Kasper then traded punches with 7:47 left in the period. Tolvanen scored his second goal of the season with 1:16 remaining. Tye Kartye and Adam Fox collected the assists on the second goal. Detroit was limited to two shots on goal in the final period. --Field Level Media

item.title: サッカー＝マンＣ、プレミアリーグの財務規定巡る判断に不服申し立て
item.description: ［マンチェスター（英国） ２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［マンチェスター（英国）　２日　ロイター］ - サッカーのイングランド・プレミアリーグのマンチェスター・シティー（マンＣ）は２日、同リーグの独立委員会から重大な財務規定違反が認定されたことを受け、不服申し立てを行ったと発表した。

プレミアリーグは９月２９日、マンＣが２００９年から１８年まで９シーズンにわたって商業パートナーとの「偽装契約」を締結し、収益を水増してコストを過少計上していたと独立委員会が認定したことを発表。９億ポンド（約１８８１億円）以上の操作を行い、財務規定を順守しているように装ったと認定した。

マンＣは多額の罰金や勝ち点剥奪、その他の競技上のペナルティーに加え、降格やタイトル剥奪の可能性も取りざたされている。

これまで不正行為を否定し続けてきたマンＣは声明で、１日の１９時に不服申し立てを行ったとし、「当クラブは、法解釈と原則、事実において、当該見解には明白かつ重大な誤りが複数含まれており、その判断が妥当性を欠くものであるという立場をとっている。当クラブはプレミアリーグによる告発について潔白であり、本件に関する当クラブの主張を裏付ける、反論の余地のない包括的な証拠が存在する」と述べた。

プレミアリーグの規定では、不服申し立てから１２週間以内に審理を行う。全面的な審理ではなく独立委員会の認定が正当か検討するもので、審理終了後３０日以内に決定を下す。

また、イングランド・サッカー協会（ＦＡ）は同日、財務規定違反が認定されてから初めてとなる公式声明で、「独立委員会の決定は、競技の公平性にとって重大な意味をもつ。われわれはその決定とそれが及ぼす影響を慎重に検討しており、適切な措置を講じる方針だ」と述べた。

item.title: ＮＢＡ＝デューレン、5年約316億円でピストンズ残留へ─報道
item.description: ［２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２日　ロイター］ - 米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のピストンズが、制限付きフリーエージェント（ＦＡ）のセンター、ジェイレン・デューレン（２２）と５年総額２億ドル（約３１６億円）の契約を結ぶことが分かった。米ＥＳＰＮとジ・アスレチックが１日に報じた。契約は全額保証されるという。

両者は数カ月にわたり契約交渉を続けていたが、合意に至っていなかった。報道によると、ピストンズは昨季プレーオフでのデューレンのパフォーマンスなどを理由に、当初は低い条件を提示していた。直近では、デューレンに同じ総額２億ドルの契約を提示したものの、体重に関する条項を盛り込んでいたという。今回の合意では同条項が削除されたと報じられている。

昨季初めてオールスターとオールＮＢＡに選出されたデューレンは、レギュラーシーズンで自己最多の１試合平均１９．５得点に、１０．５リバウンドを記録。ピストンズは６０勝２２敗で東カンファレンス最高成績を残した。一方、プレーオフでは同１０．２得点、８．５リバウンドに数字を落とし、チームは東カンファレンス準決勝でキャバリアーズに３勝４敗で敗れた。

デューレンは２０２２年ドラフト１巡目全体１３位でＮＢＡ入りし、４シーズン全てをピストンズでプレー。通算では１試合平均１３．５得点、１０．３リバウンド、２．１アシストを記録している。

item.title: Ten injured in Australia as car crashes into crowd north of Sydney
item.description: Ten people were injured when a man drove into a crowd in the Australian city of Newcastle on Saturday after appearing to lose control of the car, authorities said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ten people were injured when a man drove into a crowd in the Australian city of Newcastle on Saturday after appearing to lose control of the car, authorities said. The 18-year-old driver was arrested at the scene in the suburb of Wallsend about 110 km (70 miles) north of the New South Wales state capital, Sydney. When the incident occurred, fans had lined local streets to send off the Newcastle Knights rugby league team, due to compete in the country's National Rugby League grand final in Sydney on Sunday. Two of those hospitalised, a 5-year-old girl and a 67-year-old man, were in a critical condition, authorities said. Newcastle Mayor Gavin Morris said the driver seemed to have lost control of the car. "It appears that he was revving the car in some form," Morris said in televised remarks. Police said initial indications suggested the incident was not terrorism-related.

item.title: Dominican Republic bans Haiti from its stadiums after Nations League clash
item.description: The Dominican Republic on Friday banned Haiti's national soccer team from playing at its sports venues after crowd trouble at a Concacaf Nations League match between the two island neighbours.
item.dc:creator: Paul Mathiasen
item.content:encoded: The Dominican Republic on Friday banned Haiti's national soccer team from playing at its sports venues after crowd trouble at a Concacaf Nations League match between the two island neighbours. Sports Minister Kelvin Cruz announced the ban after incidents before the match on Thursday night at the entrances to the Felix Sanchez Olympic Stadium in Santo Domingo. Video posted on social media showed groups of fans forcing some entrances, with one gate damaged. "What we saw yesterday with a gate at the Felix Sanchez, a sports facility that has cost millions and millions of pesos to make it shine, is unacceptable," Cruz said, citing a zero-tolerance policy on indiscipline. Dominican Republic President Luis Abinader backed the decision. The Haitian Football Federation did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the ban. In a post on X after the match, the federation called it a "beautiful night for Haiti, beautiful night for the island we share," adding: "On the field, competition; off the field, respect for the neighbor." Haiti won the match 4-1, with Sunderland striker Wilson Isidor scoring twice. The win gave Haiti nine points in Group A, while the Dominican Republic stayed on six. Haiti play Costa Rica in San Jose on Sunday. Isidor was filmed saying, "Hispaniola is Haiti." Hispaniola is the Caribbean island shared by the Dominican Republic and Haiti, which have long clashed over migration and border security. Dominican federation president Jose Deschamps called Isidor's remark "a lack of respect for national sovereignty" and said the federation would file a complaint with FIFA and Concacaf. The two sports governing bodies did not immediately respond to requests for comment. Haiti's embassy in Santo Domingo said the remarks, made "in the heat of competition and the intensity characteristic of sporting events", did not reflect the position of the Haitian government and thanked Dominican authorities for the event. "Sporting rivalries must not call into question relations of good neighborliness and mutual respect that must prevail between the two states," the embassy said in a statement. Haiti and the Dominican Republic have long had tense diplomatic relations. Abinader's government has stepped up deportations of undocumented Haitians since 2024, when it pledged to deport up to [USN:S0N3L1018 TEXT:"10,000 people a week"]. Sport has been drawn into the neighbours' disputes before. In 2023, after Abinader shut the border in a dispute over a Haitian canal on the shared Massacre River, Haiti's sports ministry ordered its football federation to stop staging national team matches in the Dominican Republic.

item.title: Législatives en Lettonie dans un contexte marqué par les incursions de drones et la guerre en Ukraine
item.description: Les Lettons sont appelés aux urnes samedi pour des élections législatives qui devraient voir le Premier ministre pro-ukrainien Andris Kulbergs être reconduit à son poste, même si une profonde fragmentation politique pourrait compliquer la formation d'un gouvernement.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Les Lettons sont appelés aux urnes samedi pour des élections législatives qui devraient voir le Premier ministre pro-ukrainien Andris Kulbergs être reconduit à son poste, même si une profonde fragmentation politique pourrait compliquer la formation d'un gouvernement. De nombreux électeurs sont sur le qui-vive en Lettonie, pays balte membre de l'Otan et de l'Union européenne, après des avertissements officiels concernant une éventuelle agression russe et le nombre croissant d'incursions dans l'espace aérien liées à la guerre en Ukraine. La Russie affirme que les accusations selon lesquelles elle prévoit d'attaquer l'Otan sont sans fondement et les responsables occidentaux estiment que Moscou n'est pas en mesure de lancer une attaque directe. Les préoccupations en matière de sécurité ont toutefois pesé lourdement dans la campagne électorale en Lettonie. Les sondages créditent la Liste unie, formation centriste de Andris Kulbergs, d'environ 14% des voix, suivie de près par le parti ouvertement pro-russe "Pouvoir souverain". Andris Kulbergs, 47 ans, est arrivé au pouvoir en mai après l'effondrement de la coalition précédente, en raison de la façon dont elle a géré des incidents au cours desquels des drones militaires avaient pénétré dans l'espace aérien letton sans être détectés. Bien que ces drones fussent ukrainiens, les responsables ont accusé la Russie de les avoir fait dévier de leur trajectoire de vol. "Nous devons fournir dès maintenant à l'Ukraine tout ce qui est nécessaire pour qu'elle puisse prendre le dessus et l'emporter", a déclaré Andris Kulbergs à Reuters le mois dernier. Tout au long de la campagne, il a également promis de renforcer les capacités anti-drones de la Lettonie et de maintenir les dépenses de défense à 5% du produit intérieur brut, l'un des niveaux les plus élevés de l'Otan. Ses rivaux pro-Kremlin affirment quant à eux que la Lettonie devrait cesser toute aide à l'Ukraine et se concentrer davantage sur les questions liées au coût de la vie, en particulier au sein de la minorité russophone de son pays. "Nos électeurs veulent la paix, ne plus avoir à chercher des abris, ne plus subir les alertes aériennes", a déclaré à Reuters la présidente de "Pouvoir Souverain", Julia Stepanenko. "La guerre ne doit en aucun cas être encouragée, y compris par son financement. L'Ukraine doit gagner, mais par le biais de négociations de paix." Les bureaux de vote ouvriront samedi à 08h00 (05h00 GMT) et fermeront à 20h00. Les premiers résultats sont attendus dans les heures qui suivent et le résultat final devrait être connu après minuit.

item.title: ＭＬＢ＝ドジャース、スクバルがブレーブスとの第1戦で先発へ
item.description: ［２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）のドジャースは、３日に行われるブレーブスとのナ・リーグ地区シリーズ（ＮＬＤＳ）第１戦で左腕タリク・スクバル投手（２９）を先発起用することを決めた。

今季開幕投手を務め、昨季のプレーオフでも活躍した山本由伸投手ではなく、スクバルが第１戦を任される。スクバルは「第１戦に先発し、コーチ陣やチームメート、球団から信頼されてマウンドを託されるのは名誉であり、光栄なこと。チームを勝てる状況に持っていけるよう、自分にできることをしたい。楽しみにしている」と意気込みを示した。

ア・リーグのサイ・ヤング賞（最優秀投手賞）を２年連続で受賞しているスクバルは、８月２日にタイガースからトレードで加入。今季はタイガースで１６試合に先発して７勝５敗、防御率２．７９の数字を残し、ドジャース移籍後は１０試合で５勝２敗、防御率２．６１だった。

２０２０年にタイガースでメジャーデビューして以降、レギュラーシーズン通算では７シーズンで６６勝４４敗、防御率３．０２。タイガースで臨んだ過去２季のプレーオフでは６試合に先発して２勝１敗、防御率２．０４を記録し、チームは両年ともア・リーグ地区シリーズに進出した。

item.title: 9月雇用統計はトレンドに整合、次回会合までにさらなる情報＝クリーブランド連銀総裁
item.description:
Michael S. Derby
[２日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は２日、９月の米雇用...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
9月雇用統計はトレンドに整合、次回会合までにさらなる情報＝クリーブランド連銀総裁 10:19 配信

ニューヨーク市で2025年11月撮影　REUTERS/Brendan McDermid/File Photo

Michael S. Derby

[２日 ロイター] - 米クリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁は２日、９月の米雇用統計は最近の雇用情勢と整合的との認識を示した上で、今後の金融政策を決めるまでにはまだ時間があると述べた。

ハマック氏は米公共放送ＰＢＳの番組「ニュースアワー」のインタビューで、「過去１２カ月は平均で毎月４万１０００人の雇用が生まれている。これは私が推計する（雇用セクターの）ブレークイーブンとおおむね一致する」と述べ、労働市場が安定的に推移していることを示唆するとした。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の金融政策対応については、「月末の会合までに、さらに多くの情報が得られる。２つの責務を確実に果たせるよう、適切な政策スタンスを決める時間は十分にある」と語った。

ＦＲＢは先月、約３年ぶりに０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決定した。ハマック氏は、早い段階から利上げを支持してきた。

今週、複数のＦＲＢ高官が、追加利上げの前にデータを見極める時間があるとの認識を示した。また９月の雇用統計発表後、１０月２７─２８日の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げ観測が後退し、ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチでは据え置きの確率が８６％となっている。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：虚偽説明や失敗隠しも、中国系ＡＩエージェントにも「暴走」リスク アングル：欧米自動車メーカー、防衛需要取り込み推進　業績貢献は限定的か コラム：英バーナム首相、ＥＵ再接近に本腰　市場揺らす「ブリターン」構想 アングル：エヌビディア、ＡＩ半導体担保の巨大融資市場構想、資産価値巡りウォール街と溝 アングル：米株高支える高い増益、投資家は持続可能性に不安も 最終更新: 10/3(土) 10:19 ロイター

item.title: Vietnam's quarterly GDP grows fastest in 4 years as exports boom
item.description: Vietnam’s gross domestic product grew 9.95% in the third quarter from a year earlier, the fastest quarterly growth since the COVID pandemic, and accelerating from a revised expansion of 8.81% in the second quarter, government data showed on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Vietnam’s gross domestic product grew 9.95% in the third quarter from a year earlier, the fastest quarterly growth since the COVID pandemic, and accelerating from a revised expansion of 8.81% in the second quarter, government data showed on Saturday. Growth in the July-September quarter was driven by strong exports and robust investment in infrastructure, but remains short of the country’s full-year growth target of above 10%. The export-reliant economy has faced rising import costs this year due to the Iran war, with the trade deficit in the first nine months of this year hitting a record high. Exports of goods in September rose 39.1% from a year earlier to $59.48 billion, while imports were up 45.8% to $58.21 billion, resulting in a trade surplus of $1.27 billion for the month, the National Statistics Office said in a report. For the first nine months of this year, exports rose 24.5% to $434.30 billion, while imports were up 36.7% to $453.72 billion, translating into a trade deficit of $19.42 billion, a record high. Higher prices for energy imports were partly to blame for the widening trade deficit. Imports of crude oil in the period fell 13.5% in volume, but were up 14.4% in value, according to the report. Imports of refined fuels rose 11.5% in volume but were up 79.3% in value. Consumer prices in September rose 5.08% from a year earlier, the NSO said. Industrial production in September increased 16.7% year on year, it added. The data showed total investment in the nine-month period rose 16.7% from a year earlier, as the country has been ramping up public investment in infrastructure as part of its efforts to boost growth. Foreign investment inflows in the nine-month period rose 12.1% from a year earlier to $21.1 billion, the NSO said. The Asian Development Bank, which last week raised its forecast on Vietnam’s economic growth for this year to 7.8% from 7.2%, said the country's near-term growth prospects remain robust, underpinned by continued expansion in manufacturing, buoyant domestic consumption, and sustained foreign direct investment. However, for the longer term, it said “weaker global demand and heightened external uncertainty could weigh on growth, while higher energy prices and tighter global financial conditions could add to inflation and exchange-rate pressures.” Laura Schwartz, senior Asia analyst at risk intelligence company Verisk Maplecroft, said concerns are rising around Vietnam’s economy potentially running too hot, particularly given accelerating inflation in recent months. "Potential electricity shortfalls in the near- and mid-term will also pose significant challenges," she added.

item.title: Judge bars building of Texas-Mexico border barrier in Big Bend National Park
item.description: A federal judge on Friday barred the Trump administration from building a US-Mexico border barrier through Big Bend National Park in Texas while courts consider an environmental lawsuit challenging the project.
item.dc:creator: Steve Gorman
item.content:encoded: A federal judge on Friday barred the Trump administration from building a US-Mexico border barrier through Big Bend National Park in Texas while courts consider an environmental lawsuit challenging the project. The ruling came nearly seven weeks after US Customs and Border Protection Commissioner Rodney Scott [USN:L6N44E0WK TEXT:"paused construction"] amid bipartisan criticism of the border project and its potential impact on the park's landscape and wildlife. Customs and Border Protection has said it planned to build roads, surveillance technology and vehicle barriers in the national park, rather than the 30-foot-high (9-meter-high) walls in other border areas. Crews started clearing land in the park in August, prompting protests and lawsuits seeking to halt the work. Scott said he wanted to put the project on hold until he could visit the area, "do a personal evaluation" and speak with some of the interested parties. The preliminary injunction issued by US District Judge Kathleen Cardone effectively prevents Scott from changing his mind. It says the government "shall not build border barrier or related infrastructure, or engage in any construction of ground-disturbing activities, in the Big Bend Sector," unless it complies with environmental laws. The lawsuit was brought by the Center for Biological Diversity, a group called Friends of the Ruidosa Church and a Big Bend-area river guide and landowner. Cardone ruled that the plaintiffs were likely to prevail on at least some of their claims once the lawsuit is fully considered, and would face serious, irreparable harm without an injunction. The plaintiffs asserted that the Trump administration, including Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin, had improperly granted a sweeping waiver of environmental statutes to fast-track the Big Bend border plan. President Donald Trump, a Republican, has long touted building or reinforcing barriers along the southern US border to deter illegal immigration. But his administration's push to extend border infrastructure into Big Bend, around 250 miles (400 km) southeast of El Paso, faced opposition from local officials, conservationists and some Texas Republicans. US Senator John Cornyn, a Texas Republican, has urged Homeland Security officials to consult with local leaders and reconsider proposed barriers in Big Bend, arguing that the area's rugged terrain already provides a natural deterrent.

item.title: サッカー＝フランスはイタリアと引き分け、ジダン監督のホーム初陣
item.description: ［２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２日　ロイター］ - サッカーの欧州ネーションズリーグ（ＮＬ）は２日、各地で１次リーグの試合を行い、リーグＡの１組ではフランスがホームでイタリアに１─１で引き分けた。

フランスは０─０で迎えた後半１０分、ゴール右寄りの位置でＦＫを得ると、少し動かしたボールをミカエル・オリーズが左足でシュートし、ネットを揺らした。しかし、同２３分に自陣でのボールロストからアレッサンドロ・バストーニに同点弾を許すと、同４０分にはダヨ・ウパメカノが２枚目のイエローカードを受けて退場した。

フランス指揮官就任後のホーム初戦をドローで終えたジネディーヌ・ジダン監督は、ＴＦ１で「選手たちのことを思うと非常に残念だ。われわれはもっと良い結果に値するプレーを見せていた。選手たちを誇りに思う。ハードワークやプレッシングは、まさに模範的だった」と振り返った。

同組のもう１試合では、ベルギーがホームでトルコと対戦。ケビン・デブルイネの２得点とロメル・ルカクのゴールにより、３─０で快勝した。

この結果、１組は３試合を終えて勝ち点７のフランスが首位。ベルギーは勝ち点６の２位で、イタリアは勝ち点４の３位。勝ち点０のトルコは最下位となっている。

item.title: Ｆ１＝バーレーンＧＰフリー走行、フェルスタッペンが最速
item.description: ［セパン（マレーシア） ２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［セパン（マレーシア）　２日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１のバーレーン・グランプリ（ＧＰ）は２日、マレーシアのセパンでフリー走行を行い、レッドブルのマックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ）がこの日のトップタイムを記録した。

中東情勢を受けてマレーシアで開催されている今大会、フェルスタッペンはフリー走行１回目に１分３７秒５２０をマークした。２回目でトップだったフェラーリのシャルル・ルクレール（モナコ）が１分３７秒５２８で続き、その差はわずか０秒００８だった。

３番手は２回目に１分３７秒６２７を記録したレッドブルのアイザック・ハジャー（フランス）。昨季王者でマクラーレンのランド・ノリス（英国）が２回目に１分３７秒６６５で４番手だった。

個人総合首位のキミ・アントネッリ（メルセデス、イタリア）は２回目の１分３８秒０６０が自己ベストで８番手だった。

item.title: サッカー＝久保建英選手が結婚、俳優の福原遥さんと
item.description: ［２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２日　ロイター］ - サッカーのスペイン１部、レアル・ソシエダードに所属する日本代表ＭＦ久保建英選手が、俳優の福原遥さんと結婚したことを発表した。

両者は２日、それぞれのインスタグラムでツーショットの写真を披露し、「久保建英と福原遥は結婚致しましたことをご報告させていただきます。お互い、幼い頃からたくさんの方の支えがあって今があります。まだまだ未熟な私たちですが、皆様への感謝の気持ちを忘れることなく、共に助け合い、笑顔あふれる温かい家庭を築いていきたいと思っております」とコメントした。

２００１年生まれの久保選手は１１年にスペインの名門バルセロナの下部組織に加入。その後、ＦＣ東京で下部組織を経てトップチームデビューを飾るなどし、１９年にバルセロナの宿敵であるレアル・マドリードに移籍した。

スペインではマジョルカ、ビリャレアル、ヘタフェでもプレーした後、２２年に現在も所属するソシエダードに移籍。日本代表では１９年に１８歳でデビューを飾り、２２年と２６年のワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）に出場している。

item.title: Ataque israelense mata quatro pessoas em Gaza, dizem equipes médicas
item.description: Um ataque aéreo israelense matou pelo menos quatro palestinos em um prédio de apartamentos na Cidade de Gaza na madrugada de sábado (horário local), informaram autoridades de saúde do território.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Um ataque aéreo israelense matou pelo menos quatro palestinos em um prédio de apartamentos na Cidade de Gaza na madrugada de sábado (horário local), informaram autoridades de saúde do território. Não houve comentário imediato por parte das Forças Armadas israelenses. Os EUA mediaram um cessar-fogo no território no ano passado, mas os negociadores ainda não chegaram a um acordo sobre os termos para o desarmamento do Hamas e a retirada das tropas israelenses. Israel, que afirma que o Hamas vem se rearmando e lançando ataques em violação ao cessar-fogo de outubro, intensificou os ataques contra o grupo nas últimas semanas. O Hamas negou estar tentando realizar ataques ou reconstruir seu arsenal e acusa Israel de minar o acordo de paz de Gaza. Autoridades de saúde de Gaza afirmaram que pelo menos 1.400 palestinos foram mortos por disparos israelenses desde o cessar-fogo de outubro passado. Israel afirma que quatro de seus soldados foram mortos por militantes em Gaza no mesmo período.

item.title: Latvians vote in election in shadow of drone incursions and war in Ukraine
item.description: Latvians are voting in a parliamentary election on Saturday that is likely to keep power in the hands of pro-Ukrainian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs, although deep political fragmentation may complicate the formation of a government.
item.dc:creator: Kuba Stezycki, Janis Laizans
item.content:encoded: Latvians are voting in a parliamentary election on Saturday that is likely to keep power in the hands of pro-Ukrainian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs, although deep political fragmentation may complicate the formation of a government. Across the Baltics, including in NATO and European Union member Latvia, many voters are on edge after official warnings of potential Russian aggression and a growing number of airspace incursions related to Moscow's war in Ukraine. Russia says accusations that it is planning to attack NATO are baseless and Western officials say it is not capable of launching a direct assault, but security concerns have weighed heavily in the election campaign. "The priority, in my view, is, of course, security – security in Latvia. And then... as a student, I’d say support for students, the economy, and also support for pensioners," said Megija Nordena, 21, from Riga. [USN:L8N45L1R2 TEXT:"Opinion polls"] put Kulbergs' centrist United List ahead, with about 14% of votes, but followed closely by the overtly pro-Russian Sovereign Power. A businessman and amateur rally driver, Kulbergs, 47, came to power in May after the previous coalition crumbled over its handling of incidents in which [USN:L1N41K03T TEXT:"stray military drones flew"] undetected into Latvia. Though the drones were Ukrainian, officials [USN:L8N41X1AC TEXT:"have blamed Russia"] for causing them to divert from their flight paths. "We have to give Ukraine everything necessary right now (so) that they can have the upper hand and win", Kulbergs told Reuters in an interview. Throughout his campaign, he has also promised more anti-drone capabilities for Latvia and to maintain defence spending at 5% of gross domestic product, one of the highest levels in NATO. But his pro-Kremlin rivals say Latvia should stop any aid to Ukraine and should instead focus more on cost-of-living issues, particularly among the country's Russian-speaking minority. "Our voters want peace, to stop looking for shelters, to no longer experience the air alerts", party leader Julia Stepanenko told Reuters. "The war must not be encouraged in any way, including by financing it... Ukraine must win, but through peace talks". Polls opened at 8 a.m. (0500 GMT) and are due to close at 8 p.m., with the first results expected within hours and the final result likely to be clear after midnight. The 100 members of the Saeima, or parliament, are being elected for a four-year term. DIVIDED NATION Surveys show at least two other parties may make it into parliament - the populist, MAGA-style Latvia First grouping and the Progressives, a left-leaning party that attracts younger voters. Kulbergs' ability to forge a working coalition will depend largely on how many votes they receive and how many other parties cross the 5% threshold to enter parliament. He might also need to cobble together a deal with Latvia First leader, businessman Ainars Slesers, who appears to have shifted towards a more anti-Ukraine stance in recent months, courting votes on both sides. "His message is that (the party) condemns Russia's invasion and stands with Ukraine, but that supporting Ukraine comes at the expense of Latvia's economy," said Roberts Kits, researcher for the Latvian Strategy and Economic Research Institute, in a note. The ethnic Russian minority in Latvia is split between those who feel embarrassed or angry about Kremlin's war in Ukraine, and those frustrated with policies at home aimed at limiting their influence on public life which many see as discriminatory. Latvia, with a population of 1.9 million, is sandwiched between the Baltic Sea, with EU and NATO allies Estonia and Lithuania to the north and south, and Russia and Belarus to the east.

item.title: アジア大会＝サッカー日本女子代表、北朝鮮下し3連覇
item.description: ［２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２日　ロイター］ - 愛知・名古屋アジア大会は２日、サッカー女子決勝を行い、日本が北朝鮮との２─２からのＰＫ戦を５─３で制し、３大会連続最多４度目の優勝を果たした。

日本は前半３２分に上野真実が右足の鋭いシュートをゴール左に決めて先制。しかし、後半２分に追いつかれると、同２４分には逆転を許した。

それでも、同４１分に途中出場の西尾葉音が同点弾をマークし、延長戦へ。ＰＫ戦までもつれ込むと、北朝鮮の３人目のシュートをＧＫ大場朱羽がセーブ。日本は５人全員がＰＫを成功させた。

item.title: Hammack, do Fed, diz à PBS que ainda há tempo para avaliar próximo passo na política monetária
item.description: A presidente do Federal Reserve de Cleveland, Beth Hammack, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que o relatório de emprego dos EUA de setembro está em linha com a tendência recente de contratações, observando que ela ainda tem tempo antes de precisar tomar uma decisão sobre os próximos passos da política monetária.
item.dc:creator: Michael Derby
item.content:encoded: A presidente do Federal Reserve de Cleveland, Beth Hammack, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que o relatório de emprego dos EUA de setembro está em linha com a tendência recente de contratações, observando que ela ainda tem tempo antes de precisar tomar uma decisão sobre os próximos passos da política monetária. O relatório de empregos de setembro, que mostrou um aumento aparentemente fraco de 29 mil novos empregos e uma alta na taxa de desemprego para 4,2%, está em linha com o desempenho recente do setor, disse Hammack em entrevista ao programa PBS News Hour. “Em média, o que observamos nos últimos 12 meses foi a criação de 41.000 novos empregos por mês. Isso está amplamente alinhado com minha estimativa do ponto de equilíbrio” para o setor, o que, por sua vez, sugere uma tendência de estabilidade no mercado de trabalho, disse Hammack. Quanto à forma como o Fed deveria reagir com a política monetária, Hammack disse: “Ainda teremos muitas informações antes de nossa reunião no final do mês e, portanto, há muito tempo para tomar uma decisão sobre qual é a postura correta da política para garantir que estejamos cumprindo ambos os aspectos de nosso mandato.” Hammack tem sido uma defensora firme e precoce do aumento das taxas para reduzir as pressões inflacionárias que ela e seus pares do banco central consideram excessivas. Nesta semana, várias autoridades importantes do Fed afirmaram que o Fed tem tempo para avaliar os dados antes de aumentar as taxas novamente. No mês passado, o Fed elevou sua meta de taxa de juros em um quarto de ponto percentual, para uma faixa entre 3,75% e 4%, enquanto as autoridades sinalizavam a expectativa de outro aumento antes do final do ano. Os comentários das autoridades nesta semana indicaram que não é provável que haja qualquer ação sobre as taxas na reunião do Comitê Federal de Mercado Aberto (Fomc) marcada para 27 e 28 de outubro.

item.title: Israeli strike kills five, including four women, in Gaza, health officials say
item.description: An Israeli airstrike killed at least five Palestinians, including four women, in an apartment building in Gaza City early on Saturday, health and civil defense service officials said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An Israeli airstrike killed at least five Palestinians, including four women, in an apartment building in Gaza City early on Saturday, health and civil defense service officials said. Among the dead were a Christian mother and her daughter, medics said. There was no immediate comment from the Israeli military. The strike destroyed the apartment building and started a fire. "We were asleep and suddenly heard continuous strikes, and heavy explosions, the children woke up startled and started running and screaming," said eyewitness Ahmed Al-Dahdouh. "We ran out and found that our neighbour's house was struck and there were dismembered martyrs, women, men and children, we started to pull them out, they were scattered under the rubble," he told Reuters. Last year's US-brokered Gaza ceasefire calls for eventual reconstruction of the territory. But little progress has been made towards implementing a deal to end the conflict that includes terms for Hamas to disarm and Israel to withdraw its troops. "We are Muslims and these are our Christian brethren, who are not involved in anything, they are peaceful people, and everybody loves them, and now we pulled out their bodies, a mother and her daughter," said Dahdouh. Israel, which says Hamas has been rearming and launching attacks in violation of the ceasefire, has stepped up strikes on the group in recent weeks. Hamas has denied trying to carry out attacks or rebuild its arsenal and accuses Israel of undermining the Gaza peace deal. Gaza health officials have said at least 1,400 Palestinians have been killed by Israeli fire since last October's ceasefire. Israel says four of its soldiers have been killed by militants in Gaza over the same period.

item.title: Chinese Auto Show Debuts in Argentina as Sales Surge
item.description: By Leila Miller BUENOS AIRES, Oct 2 (Reuters) – Buenos Aires is hosting its first Chinese auto show on Friday as Argentina’s car market under President Javier Milei has shifted from heavy protectionism to a more open and competitive environment. Chinese brands are flooding the …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
By Leila Miller

BUENOS AIRES, Oct 2 (Reuters) – Buenos Aires is hosting its first Chinese auto show on Friday as Argentina’s car market under President Javier Milei has shifted from heavy protectionism to a more open and competitive environment.

Chinese brands are flooding the market, benefiting from a measure that allows up to 50,000 electric and hybrid vehicles without tariffs in 2026. Chinese brands accounted for 10% of car and light commercial vehicle sales in Argentina in August, up from about 2% late last year.

Since launching in Argentina in late 2025, China’s electric-vehicle maker BYD has become the ninth-best-selling car brand. The company leads electric car sales in Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador and Uruguay.

At the auto show, more than 20 Chinese brands, including Geely, Chery, GWM and Dongfeng, were on display. German Molina, a 3D designer who already owns a Chinese car and wants to buy another, looked around with his wife and son.

“If you go out onto the main avenues or neighborhoods, you see a large number of Chinese cars, and it’s not just one brand, but many different ones,” said Molina. “I believe it’s only a matter of time before people start embracing them a bit more.”

An Omoda hybrid system is on display at the first Chinese auto show in Argentina on October 2, 2026, as Chinese automakers expand in the country. REUTERS/Alessia Maccioni

Sebastian Beato, president of Argentina’s auto dealers’ association ACARA, said the “impressive” growth among Chinese brands had pushed the national industry to produce new models, such as the Renault Niagara pick-up truck unveiled in September.

Earlier this week the Argentine government said Japanese automaker Toyota Motor would invest $1.34 billion to develop an EV plant in Argentina.

If Argentina’s auto industry doesn’t transform, “it’s going to have obsolete cars,” Beato said.

Milei Unconcerned

Chinese automakers are steadily expanding across Latin America, selling both traditional vehicles and EVs at a pace that has alarmed some local markets.

Brazil and Mexico have introduced tariffs aimed at slowing the influx and protecting domestic manufacturing jobs. But Milei, a libertarian, has said he is unconcerned by the rapid growth of BYD and dismissed suggestions that it could complicate his close relationship with the U.S. during an interview last month.

“What Argentines buy is the problem of Argentines,” Milei told Bloomberg at the Economic Club of New York.

Tesla in July launched operations in Uruguay, and there are signs the U.S. automaker could soon enter Argentina.

A Haval vehicle is displayed during the first Chinese auto show in Argentina on October 2, 2026. Chinese automakers are expanding in the country as the Argentinian government opens up the market, boosting competition in the automotive sector. REUTERS/Alessia Maccioni

The registration of Tesla Argentina appeared in the country’s official gazette in April, and state energy company YPF said in June it had signed a letter of intent with Tesla to explore energy storage opportunities.

Tesla did not respond to a request for comment.

‘Possibility to Compete’

Car sales in Argentina have fallen 13% so far this year from the same period in 2025, a decline that industry analysts attribute to a market adjustment after last year’s strong growth was fueled by lower trade barriers. High interest rates have also dissuaded consumers from taking out car loans.

Andres Civetta, an economist at consultancy Abeceb, said Argentina’s auto industry should focus on pick-up trucks, where the country has established a strong export position and doesn’t yet face competition from Chinese brands.

Fernando Rodriguez Canedo, executive director of Argentina’s association of car factories, welcomed Milei’s gradual rollback of national export duties and said the industry was also pressing provincial governments to reduce local taxes.

“That would give us the possibility to compete,” Canedo said.

item.title: Tennessee execution survivor Christa Pike on ventilator, attorneys say
item.description: The lawyers accused Correction Department officials of shrugging off prior warnings that pre-existing medical conditions would make placing IV lines especially difficult.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Tennessee execution survivor Christa Pike on ventilator, attorneys say

The lawyers accused Correction Department officials of shrugging off prior warnings that pre-existing medical conditions would make placing IV lines especially difficult.

A picture taken on Dec 4, 2007, shows death-row inmate Christa Pike entering the Knox County Criminal Court in Knoxville, Tennessee, US, obtained by Reuters on Sep 30, 2026. (File photo: J. Miles Cary/ Knoxville News Sentinel/USA Today Network via Reuters)

NASHVILLE: Convicted killer Christa Pike was left gravely ill, unconscious and hospitalised on life support after Tennessee's failed attempt to execute her by lethal injection, her lawyers said on Friday (Oct 2), providing the first detailed account of the injuries she suffered. Hospital staff were working to save Pike's life and clear the drug pentobarbital from her system, her attorneys said in an emergency motion, which seeks a court order for Tennessee's Department of Correction to preserve evidence from Wednesday night's botched execution. Pike remained in critical condition, intubated and hooked to a mechanical ventilator to breathe, her lawyers said, after two doses of pentobarbital were administered to her intravenously at the Riverbend Maximum Security Institution in Nashville, the state capital. The bungled attempt to establish intravenous lines also left both her arms "swollen, burned and blistered", the apparent result of the pentobarbital, a highly alkaline and caustic substance, seeping into the tissues under her skin, the court filing said. 'VEINS HAD BLOWN'
